justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/compilation/ICompilationVisitable.java, AbstractCompilationVisitable.java, AbstractCompilationWalker.java, and CompilationUtil.java. The exact package contains only 4 classes (about 492 LOC total): three are very small interface/abstract base types (14-32 LOC each), and the only substantial class, CompilationUtil.java (423 LOC), is a focused helper for compilation/tag parsing, tag walking, and member-ID matching rather than a broad collection of unrelated responsibilities. The codecache subpackage is separate and was excluded.
